title: Arbitrary Code Execution via Python Pickle __reduce__
evidence: Pickle REDUCE opcode (0x52) detected with os.system reference in GLOBAL opcode. Disassembly shows c__builtin__\neval\n... pattern.
reproduction: 1. Craft pickle payload with __reduce__ returning (os.system, ('id',))\n2. Send to /api/deserialize endpoint\n3. Command output returned in response
impact: Remote code execution with the privileges of the application process. Full server compromise possible.
remediation: Replace pickle.loads() with JSON deserialization. If pickle is required, implement a RestrictedUnpickler that only allows safe types via find_class() override.

title: Java CommonsCollections1 RCE via ObjectInputStream
evidence: 0xACED0005 magic bytes detected. String 'org.apache.commons.collections.Transformer' found in stream. InvokerTransformer class descriptor present.
reproduction: 1. Generate CC1 payload with ysoserial: java -jar ysoserial.jar CommonsCollections1 'id'\n2. Send base64-encoded payload to Java RMI endpoint\n3. Command executes on server
impact: Full remote code execution on Java application server. Access to all application data, credentials, and internal network.
remediation: Upgrade Apache Commons Collections to 3.2.2+. Implement JEP 290 ObjectInputFilter. Consider serialization allowlisting.

title: .NET ViewState MAC Validation Bypass
evidence: ViewState accepted without MachineKey validation. enableViewStateMac=false detected in web.config. BinaryFormatter used for ViewState deserialization.
reproduction:
1. Disable ViewState MAC in web.config
2. Craft malicious ViewState with ObjectDataProvider gadget
3. Submit in __VIEWSTATE POST parameter
4. ObjectDataProvider.MethodName executes on server
impact: Remote code execution via .NET deserialization gadget chain. Compromises the ASP.NET application and its data.
remediation: Enable ViewState MAC validation (enableViewStateMac=true). Configure MachineKey in web.config. Upgrade to .NET 5+ where BinaryFormatter is disabled.

title: PyTorch Model File Executes Arbitrary Code on Load
evidence: torch.load() called without weights_only=True. Model file contains REDUCE opcode targeting subprocess.Popen. Payload verified to execute on load.
reproduction: 1. Craft malicious .pt file with embedded pickle payload\n2. Upload to model serving endpoint\n3. torch.load(path) executes payload on model load
impact: Code execution on ML serving infrastructure. Access to training data, model weights, and internal services.
remediation: Use torch.load(..., weights_only=True). Verify model file hashes. Use safetensors format for model sharing.
